notes:
Context: Keystone builds a payments orchestration layer and realtime conversational checkout assistant. Primary constraint: 35-50ms p99 latency for inline scoring path (fraud risk + eligibility) at peak 3k-6k RPS. Budget: highly cost-sensitive — want to prefer batching/caching/quantization levers before adding hardware.

Key ask from AE/SE conversations:
- Concrete perf benchmark: p50/p95/p99 latency and cost per 1M tokens for candidate models (Llama2-13B, open-variant-7B) across Redwood Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private setups.
- Quantization comparison: float16 vs int8_dynamic vs int4 (where supported) with regression numbers on the in-house eval set (false-positive delta threshold 0.5%).
- Batching & throughput: show continuous batching policies effects on latency tail at target SLOs; provide batching guidelines (max batch, wait window) tuned to their traffic mix (many short sessions + long-form follow-ups).
- Caching: test prefix/KV caching across repeated payment flows and average token savings; show eviction policy suggestions for sessions with 70% shared prefix.
- Routing/fallback: require graceful fallback to smaller quantized variant on preemption; need policy that prioritizes latency-SLO for inline scoring.

Sales notes / quotes:
- CTO (A. Mitchell): "If we can hit 45ms p99 with cost under $X/1M tokens we're ready to commit."
- Head of Infra: concerned about multitenant jitter; asked about VPC/private control plane timelines.

Procurement/Legal: asked for SOC2/ISO proof, KMS integration details, and a clause for EU data residency.

Internal ops comment: prefer Dedicated reserved nodes with burst capacity + on-prem pilot for regulated merchants. High interest in Redwood Optimize automated batching and quantization recommendations.

Stated blockers: legal residency confirmation, exact ARR vs budget alignment, and agreement on evaluation metrics (latency vs FP delta).

requirements_summary: Realtime scoring + chat assistant. SLO: p99 <= 50ms for inline fraud/eligibility calls; sustained throughput 3k-6k RPS with 10k/day peak bursts. Cost target: minimize $/1M tokens; willing to trade small accuracy delta for 2-3x cost improvement via quantization and caching. Must support SSO/SAML, KMS, audit logs, EU residency option. Need deterministic rollout path (canary/A-B) and automatic fallback to lower-cost model when latency or capacity pressure detected.
throughput_targets: sustained 3000-6000 RPS; burstable to ~10k RPS for 10-30 minute windows
model_preferences: Llama2-13B (primary), open-7B (fallback); explore quantized int8/int4 where quality impact acceptable
perf_requests: Run 3 variants of perf harness: (1) baseline float16 no batching, (2) int8 with continuous batching+wait-window tuning, (3) int4 (if available) with aggressive caching. Provide cost per 1M tokens and p50/p95/p99 histograms. Include KV cache hit-rate experiments using provided trace.
closing_notes: High technical buy-in from infra and ML teams. Decision dependent on benchmark results (latency & cost). AE to coordinate POC kickoff and legal for residency clause. Timing sensitive — hoping to close by 2026-05 if POC shows required tradeoffs.
